title: الشرع: سوريا تحولت من مُصدر للأزمات إلى نموذج للاستقرار
content: قال الرئيس السوري أحمد الشرع اليوم السبت إن بلاده تسير في الاتجاه الصحيح وتحولت من منطقة مصدرة للأزمات إلى نموذج للاستقرار، مشيرا إلى أن كل الخطوات التي اتخذتها الحكومة تصب في المصلحة العامة السورية.

title: دمار وخسائر فادحة جراء الفيضانات في إندونيسيا

title: الفقر والبطالة ودمار البنية التحتية.. تحديات تواجه الحكومة السورية

title: Syrian president warns Israel against tampering with 1974 ceasefire agreement
content: Speaking at Doha Forum, al-Sharaa warns any attempt to alter 1974 Disengagement Agreement to turn region into 'dangerous place with unknown consequences'

title: Lebanese army arrests six after gunmen attack UN peacekeepers in south
content: Arrests made after President Aoun met UNSC delegation, which will visit south to get 'real picture' of what is going on.

title: Beware the Liz Truss chatshow: viewers will require survivor therapy
content:
SuperLiz reboots herself inside a utility room, delivering nonsense so pure even her guests look trapped

We happy few. We unlucky few. In years to come when we are all still recovering from post-traumatic stress disorder, we will be able to say we were there. That we have seen things that cannot be unseen. The 8,000 of us who, through a mixture of curiosity and comedy, chose to watch Liz Truss commit a drive-by on herself. Though only a very few will have made it to the end.

Some won’t have even made it to the start. The show started an hour late because Liz forgot to put her watch back in October. Still, this was an award-winning YouTube TV show. Though not the awards anyone would want to collect.

title: Tower of London partially closed after food thrown at crown jewels display
content:
Four people arrested after protest against UK inequality claimed by civil-resistance group Take Back Power

Part of the Tower of London has been closed to visitors after food was thrown at a display case containing the crown jewels in a protest against inequality in the UK.

Four people were arrested on Saturday after the action, which was claimed by Take Back Power – a self-described non-violent civil-resistance group. It said custard and apple crumble was flung at the case, which contained the imperial state crown.
